fixtures.title: Input components
fixtures.behavior: Native, masked, disabled, readonly, dynamic, validated, debounced, autosuggest and keyboard autocomplete inputs expose deterministic visible state.
intentionalDefects: The placeholder-only input has no associated label.
expectedOutcomes: Labelled inputs retain values and dynamic controls expose visible results.
Keyboard autocomplete selects the active option.

fixtures.title: Button components
fixtures.behavior: Native actions, form buttons, enabled conditions, gestures, bounded delay, DOM replacement, duplicate labels, nested scope and delayed appearance report visible outcomes.
intentionalDefects: One icon-only button has no accessible name.
expectedOutcomes: Each enabled action produces an assertion-ready status message.
The replacement button detaches the original DOM node.

fixtures.title: Checkboxes and radio buttons
fixtures.behavior: Native single, grouped, disabled, dynamic, indeterminate, hierarchical, generated, conditional and duplicate-label choices expose deterministic state.
expectedOutcomes: Partial selection sets the parent indeterminate state.
Parent choices propagate to children and radio selections reveal visible results.

fixtures.title: Dropdown components
fixtures.behavior: Native, multi, grouped, searchable and ARIA listboxes support selection while dependent locations and infinite products load from the isolated API.
expectedOutcomes: ARIA options support keyboard selection.
API-backed options enable in dependency order and paged products append on scroll.

fixtures.title: Realistic forms
fixtures.behavior: Six realistic forms expose required and conditional client validation, inline and summary errors, API success, simulated server errors and duplicate-data conflict behavior.
intentionalDefects: The login form validates UI only; real authentication is reserved for Chunk 8.
expectedOutcomes: Invalid input is blocked with inline and summary errors.
Valid API-backed forms show a created record ID and duplicate email returns 409.

fixtures.title: Playwright Locator Lab
fixtures.behavior: Fourteen semantic, fallback, filtering, position, chaining and scoping topics pair accessible Good DOM with visibly marked Awkward DOM.
intentionalDefects: Awkward DOM examples contain missing labels, missing roles, duplicate text, missing alt text and implementation-coupled markup.
expectedOutcomes: Every topic contains Good DOM and Awkward DOM examples.
Awkward regions remain excluded from the general accessibility scan and their exact defects are asserted separately.

fixtures.title: Table Lab
fixtures.behavior: API employee data powers static, sortable, searchable, filterable, client/server paginated, editable, dynamic, selectable, expandable, sticky, virtualized, asynchronous and nested table exercises. A refreshable customer table exposes session-scoped API setup for API-to-UI tests.
expectedOutcomes: Multi-column sorting exposes visible priorities and aria-sort state.
API edits persist in the current sandbox and reset restores seed data.
The 10,000-row view keeps fewer than 40 data rows mounted in the DOM.

fixtures.title: Search and Lists Lab
fixtures.behavior: Synthetic employee and product data powers instant, controlled-delay and debounced search, keyboard autocomplete, combined filters, explicit empty state, load-more pagination and cursor-backed infinite scrolling.
expectedOutcomes: Each search timing model reports its applied state and result count.
API pages append without duplicates and end with an explicit end-of-list state.

fixtures.title: Playwright Waits Lab
fixtures.behavior: Bounded delay controls drive appearance, enabled, text, loading, progress, network, dropdown, lazy-content and infinite-scroll synchronization exercises.
expectedOutcomes: The same seed produces the same bounded random delay.
Every asynchronous state exposes a visible assertion target without fixed test sleeps.

fixtures.title: Dynamic DOM Lab
fixtures.behavior: A marked practice fixture deterministically rotates IDs, classes and order while preserving semantic contracts across duplicate, replacement and API-rendered DOM.
intentionalDefects: Generated IDs and classes change on each controlled render.
Repeated text and a hidden duplicate deliberately make unscoped text and position selectors ambiguous.
expectedOutcomes: Semantic scoped locators survive generated selector and order changes.
The original card detaches when a replacement node is rendered.

fixtures.title: Dialogs, Modals, and Toasts
fixtures.behavior: Native alerts, confirms and prompts pair with focus-contained application dialogs and role-correct configurable toast notifications.
expectedOutcomes: Every browser dialog writes its accepted or dismissed result visibly.
Application dialogs trap focus and close with Escape; toast roles match urgency.

fixtures.title: Interaction Lab
fixtures.behavior: Hover, tooltip, pointer gestures, scrolling, Enter, Tab, Escape, command shortcut, arrow navigation and autocomplete all append to one visible log.
expectedOutcomes: Every interaction appends a stable human-readable log entry.
Listbox and autocomplete selections work with keyboard-only input.

fixtures.title: Date, Time, and Range Controls
fixtures.behavior: Native and custom calendar controls, ranges, fixed timezone output, sliders, linked numeric values, a stepper and async progress expose normalized results.
expectedOutcomes: Date selections and timezone output are deterministic and normalized.
Numeric controls keep linked visible values synchronized and async progress reaches 100 percent.

fixtures.title: Frames and Windows Lab
fixtures.behavior: Single, form, nested, multiple and dynamic same-origin frames pair with tabs, popups and validated postMessage parent updates.
expectedOutcomes: Every frame stays under /practice/ and is scoped by a stable accessible title.
Tabs and popups return deterministic results without third-party content.

fixtures.title: Files Lab
fixtures.behavior: Native and dropzone uploads enforce extension, MIME, content, size, quota, private random storage and TTL controls; deterministic downloads expose attachment filenames.
expectedOutcomes: Only content-matched allowlisted files receive opaque non-executable private storage names.
Rejected active content and traversal attempts never reach storage; downloads expose deterministic suggested filenames.

fixtures.title: Drag and Drop Lab
fixtures.behavior: Cards and sortable items support HTML5, pointer and keyboard movement; a shared file dropzone and tasks-API Kanban expose visible persisted outcomes.
expectedOutcomes: Card and sort order changes are visible and keyboard-reachable.
A Kanban drop persists the task status only in the current sandbox.

fixtures.title: Browser Context Lab
fixtures.behavior: Fixture cookies, storage, secure-context permissions, offline requests and fixed responsive breakpoints expose named visible states for BrowserContext automation.
expectedOutcomes: Cookie and storage operations remain fixture-local and visible while the Lab session cookie stays HttpOnly.
Granted, denied, offline and responsive states are deterministic and assertion-ready.

fixtures.title: Practice Authentication Sandbox
fixtures.behavior: Public synthetic accounts exercise registration, non-enumerating login and reset, HttpOnly sessions, deterministic lockout and expiry, roles, bearer tokens, refresh tokens and API keys without WordPress identity access. Authenticated identities expose a stable Account dashboard heading.
expectedOutcomes: Missing authentication returns 401 while authenticated roles without permission return 403.
Logout, idle expiry, token expiry, refresh rotation, lockout and password reset are deterministic and server-enforced.
Passwords remain hashed, cookie mutations require CSRF, and authentication data stays inside the Lab sandbox.

fixtures.title: Testheon Store
fixtures.behavior: A session-scoped shop connects catalogue search and filters, product variants, guest cart, Chunk 8 login, deterministic coupons, fake checkout, order history, API setup and verification, one-shot network errors, and stable visual mode. The seed includes Arka 14 Laptop at ₹49,999 for budget-search challenges.
expectedOutcomes: The guest cart survives the authenticated checkout handoff and the resulting order is readable through the Practice API.
Search, category, price, rating, sort and pagination produce deterministic catalogue results.
Every one-shot failure, malformed payload and empty array renders an assertion-ready UI state without a real vulnerability or external payment call.
